## Setting up the document

Packages & directories
```{r, include = F}
# 1. Dependencies
# Clear the workspace so a rerun starts from a known-empty state.

#rm(list = ls())

# Packages and the shared ggplot theme are defined once in shared/dependencies.R
# (see the root README), so a clean clone reproduces without editing this
# notebook. here::here() resolves paths from the .here file at the repo root;
# bootstrap the here package itself first in case it is missing.
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("shared", "dependencies.R"))

# 2. Paths - portable, anchored by the .here file at the repo root (nothing
# machine-specific). Trailing "/" is kept so the paste0(path.*, "file") calls
# used throughout the notebook still resolve.
base         <- here::here("experiments", "Experiment_2")
path.raw     <- paste0(base, "/data/raw/")                   # measured inputs: 1 - Exp2_Biomass.csv, 2 - Mech/, images/
path.mech    <- paste0(base, "/data/raw/2 - Mech/")          # mechanical test exports (Exp2_*.csv)
path.gv      <- paste0(base, "/data/processed/grey_values/") # ImageJ surface CSVs (Exp2_A1..L3)
path.figures <- paste0(base, "/results/figures/")            # final paper figures (ggsave)
path.tables  <- paste0(base, "/results/tables/")             # final paper tables
```

```{r}
my_palette3 <- c("#C08FE2", "#813EAF", "#4F0A80")
```

Function to add new factors in dataframes
```{r}
conditions_bp <- function(data) {
  
  data %>%
    mutate(
      Levels = case_when(
        Condition == "P1" ~ 1,
        Condition == "P3" ~ 2,
        Condition == "P2" ~ 3,
        Condition == "T1" ~ 4,
        Condition == "T3" ~ 5,
        Condition == "T2" ~ 6
      ),
      Levels = factor(Levels, levels = 1:6),
      
      New_condition = factor(case_when(
        Condition == "P1" ~ "A1",
        Condition == "P3" ~ "A2",
        Condition == "P2" ~ "A3",
        Condition == "T1" ~ "L1",
        Condition == "T3" ~ "L2",
        Condition == "T2" ~ "L3"
      )),
      
      InN = factor(if_else(Levels %in% 1:3, 1, 2)),
      
      PrN = factor(case_when(
        Levels %in% c(1, 4) ~ 1,
        Levels %in% c(2, 5) ~ 2,
        Levels %in% c(3, 6) ~ 3
      )),
      
      In = factor(if_else(Levels %in% 1:3,
                          conditions2[1],
                          conditions2[2])),
      
      Pr = factor(case_when(
        Levels %in% c(1, 4) ~ conditions3[1],
        Levels %in% c(2, 5) ~ conditions3[2],
        Levels %in% c(3, 6) ~ conditions3[3]
      ))
    )
}


```


Helpers: significance letters ordered by magnitude
```{r}
# The compact-letter displays in this notebook follow the paper's convention:
# "a" is the group with the HIGHEST mean (or median), "b" the next, and so on.
# multcompLetters() labels groups in source order, so these helpers relabel them
# by magnitude.

# Parametric (aov + Tukey): letters ordered by descending group mean (a = highest).
# Pass the fitted aov and the factor name; returns a named vector (names = group
# levels) to index by group, e.g. cld_desc(aov(y ~ g, data), "g")[as.character(g)].
cld_desc <- function(model, term) multcompView::multcompLetters4(model, TukeyHSD(model))[[term]]$Letters

# Non-parametric, 2 groups (e.g. by inoculum): order the two letters by descending
# median. p = adjusted wilcoxon p-value; returns a named vector by group.
cld_median2 <- function(p, values, groups) {
  med <- tapply(values, groups, median)
  ord <- names(sort(med, decreasing = TRUE))
  if (!is.na(p) && p < 0.05) setNames(c("a", "b"), ord) else setNames(c("a", "a"), ord)
}

# Non-parametric, 3+ groups (e.g. by level or by process): pairwise Wilcoxon (BH)
# compact-letter display. multcompLetters() gives the correct grouping but labels
# in an arbitrary order, so the letters are relabelled by descending group median
# ("a" = highest-median group), matching the paper's convention and the parametric
# cld_desc() above. Returns a named vector (names = group levels) to index by group.
cld_wilcox_desc <- function(values, groups, p.adjust.method = "BH") {
  groups <- as.character(groups)
  pv  <- suppressWarnings(pairwise.wilcox.test(values, groups, p.adjust.method = p.adjust.method)$p.value)
  pv_vec <- as.vector(pv)
  names(pv_vec) <- paste(rep(rownames(pv), ncol(pv)),
                         rep(colnames(pv), each = nrow(pv)), sep = "-")
  pv_vec <- pv_vec[!is.na(pv_vec)]
  L <- multcompView::multcompLetters(pv_vec)$Letters      # correct grouping, arbitrary labels
  score <- tapply(values, groups, median)                 # relabel so a = highest median
  distinct <- unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(L, collapse = ""), "")))
  lscore <- sapply(distinct, function(ch) max(score[names(L)[grepl(ch, L, fixed = TRUE)]]))
  neworder <- names(sort(lscore, decreasing = TRUE))
  remap <- setNames(letters[seq_along(neworder)], neworder)
  vapply(L, function(s) paste(sort(remap[strsplit(s, "")[[1]]]), collapse = ""), character(1))
}
```

### DATAFRAMES
Biomass dataframe: my_data
```{r}
my_data <- read.csv(paste0(path.raw, "1 - Exp2_Biomass.csv"))
res.df <- my_data %>%
  dplyr::select(Condition, Levels, Replicate, pH, FBM, DBM) %>%
  dplyr::rename(GBM = DBM) %>%                 # DBM column from the CSV = glycerol biomass
  mutate(cDBM = FBM * 0.0547) %>%              # calculated dry biomass (regression on fresh biomass)
  conditions_bp() %>%
  mutate(Ident = paste0(New_condition, "_", Replicate))
head(res.df)
```
## Biomass

### Fresh biomass by level
Stats fresh biomass by level
```{r}
## Tables mean by Level
mean.FBM <- res.df %>% 
  group_by(Levels, New_condition, In, Pr, InN, PrN) %>%
  summarise_at("FBM", list(mean = mean, sd = sd)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
mean.FBM
```


Fresh biomass significance by level
```{r}
results <- lm(FBM~Levels, data=res.df)
plot(results,which=2)
shapiro.test(residuals(results))
leveneTest(FBM~Levels, data=res.df)

# Letters ordered by descending mean (a = highest), computed from Tukey via cld_desc().
cld <- cld_desc(aov(FBM ~ Levels, data = res.df), "Levels")
mean.signif.FBM <- mean.FBM %>% mutate(Letter = cld[as.character(Levels)])
mean.signif.FBM
#write.table(mean.signif.FBM, file = paste0(path.tables, "2 - Exp2_FBM_byLevel_stats.csv"), dec = '.', sep =",", row.names = F)
```

Fresh biomass plot by level
```{r}
graph_FBM <- ggplot(res.df, aes(x = Levels, y = FBM, group = Levels, fill = Levels)) +
  labs(y = "Biomass (g)", x = NULL) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = NULL, values = my_palette, labels = conditions) +
  geom_text(data = mean.signif.FBM,
            aes(x = Levels, label = Letter,
                y = mean + c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.8, 0.8, 0.8), group = Levels),
            colour = "black") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +   # two rows, filled left to right
  theme(axis.text.x  = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
        legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.direction = "horizontal",
        legend.title     = element_blank(),
        legend.margin    = margin(t = -5))                # pulls the legend closer to the plot
graph_FBM
#ggsave(paste0(path.figures, "1. Exp2_FBM.svg"), graph_FBM, width=8, height=7, units="cm", scale=1.2)
```

### Fresh biomass by proc
Stats fresh biomass by proc
```{r}
## Tables mean by Proc

  group_by(Pr) %>%
  summarise_at("FBM", list(mean = mean, sd = sd)) %>%

```

Fresh biomass significance by proc
```{r}
results <- lm(FBM~Pr, data=res.df)
plot(results,which=2)
shapiro.test(residuals(results))
leveneTest(FBM~Pr, data=res.df)

# Additive model: process (B / BS / BSB) on its own shows NO significant
# differences (all "a"). Letters ordered by descending mean via cld_desc().
cld <- cld_desc(aov(FBM ~ Pr, data = res.df), "Pr")
mean.signif.FBM3 <- mean.FBM3 %>% mutate(Letter = cld[as.character(Pr)])
mean.signif.FBM3
#write.table(mean.signif.FBM3, file = paste0(path.tables, "2 - Exp2_FBM_byProc_stats.csv"), dec = '.', sep =",", row.names = F)
```
```{r}
# Interaction model: once inoculation (In) is in the model, the process effect
# DOES become significant (B differs from BS/BSB). Kept alongside the additive
# result above to document that contrast, and written to its own object so the
# two do not overwrite each other. Letters from the interaction model's Pr term.
results <- lm(FBM ~ Pr * In, data = res.df)
plot(results, which = 2)
shapiro.test(residuals(results))
leveneTest(FBM ~ Pr * In, data = res.df)

cld <- cld_desc(aov(FBM ~ Pr * In, data = res.df), "Pr")
mean.signif.FBM3.int <- mean.FBM3 %>% mutate(Letter = cld[as.character(Pr)])
mean.signif.FBM3.int

```

### Fresh vs glycerol
### Fresh vs glycerol by inoc
The effect of glycerol is indistinct regardless of In. There is no evidence that more glycerol enters the liquid initiated samples.
```{r}
agar_dbm <- res.df$GBM[res.df$In == "Agar"]
agar_fbm <- res.df$FBM[res.df$In == "Agar"]
agar_reduction <- agar_dbm/agar_fbm
mean(agar_reduction)
sd(agar_reduction)

liquid_dbm <- res.df$GBM[res.df$In == "Liquid"]
liquid_fbm <- res.df$FBM[res.df$In == "Liquid"]
liquid_reduction <- liquid_dbm/liquid_fbm
mean(liquid_reduction)
sd(liquid_reduction)

reduction_df <- data.frame(reduction = c(agar_reduction, liquid_reduction), In = c(rep("Agar",9), rep("Liquid",9)))
summary(aov(reduction~In, data=reduction_df))
```

## Surface area from backlit
### Surface dataframe
```{r}
## 11. Load Surface data
# Surface comes from the ImageJ CSVs in data/processed/grey_values (Exp2_A1..L3);
# setwd() so surface_read()'s bare-filename reads resolve. Portable via here().
setwd(path.gv)
csvs <- list.files(path.gv, pattern = "*.csv")
csv <- csvs[1]
scale <- 84.8116 # pixels per cm 

surface_read <- function(csv){
  csv
  df <- read.csv(csv, sep = ",", dec = ".") %>%
    mutate(origin = gsub(".csv","",csv)) %>% # Create a column named origin with the name of the file
    separate_wider_delim(origin, names = c("Experiment", "Condition"), delim = "_") %>%
    mutate(Biorep = case_when(XM < 1000 ~ 1,
                              XM >= 1000 & XM < 2000 ~ 2,
                              XM >= 2000 ~ 3)) %>%
    mutate(Radio_px = sqrt(Area/pi),
           Radio_cm = Radio_px/scale,
           Area_cm2 = Radio_cm^2*pi,
           Area_m2 = Area_cm2/10^4,
           Ident = paste0(Condition, "_", Biorep)) %>%
    dplyr::select(Condition, Area_m2, Ident) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  return(df)
}

area.df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(csvs, surface_read)) %>%
  mutate(New_condition = as.factor(Condition),
         Levels = case_when(
           Condition == "A1" ~ 1,
           Condition == "A2" ~ 2,
           Condition == "A3" ~ 3,
           Condition == "L1" ~ 4,
           Condition == "L2" ~ 5,
           Condition == "L3" ~ 6),
         Levels = factor(Levels, levels = 1:6),
         InN = factor(if_else(Levels %in% 1:3, 1, 2)),
         PrN = factor(case_when(
           Levels %in% c(1, 4) ~ 1,
           Levels %in% c(2, 5) ~ 2,
           Levels %in% c(3, 6) ~ 3)),
         In = factor(if_else(Levels %in% 1:3,
                          conditions2[1],
                          conditions2[2])),
         Pr = factor(case_when(
        Levels %in% c(1, 4) ~ conditions3[1],
        Levels %in% c(2, 5) ~ conditions3[2],
        Levels %in% c(3, 6) ~ conditions3[3]))) %>%
  mutate(Surface = Area_m2*10000)
head(area.df)
```

### Faulted tests (one per Ident_rep)
Read files
```{r}

# Mechanical test exports live in data/raw/2 - Mech (path.mech, from the setup
# chunk). setwd() so csv_read()'s bare-filename reads resolve.
setwd(path.mech)
csvs <- list.files(path.mech, pattern = "*.csv")
csv <- csvs[1]

csv_read <- function(csv) {
  read.csv(csv, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", skip = 18, nrows = 1, fileEncoding = "UTF-16LE") %>%
    transmute(Comment = V2, origin = sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(csv))) %>%
    separate_wider_delim(origin, names = c("Experiment", "Biorep", "Techrep"), delim = "_") %>%
    separate_wider_delim(Biorep, names = c("Condition", "Biorep"), delim = "-") %>%
    dplyr::select(Condition, Biorep, Techrep, Comment)
}
df <- bind_rows(lapply(csvs, csv_read))
```
Dataframe
```{r}
df_foul <- df %>%
  filter(str_detect(Comment, regex("tape|clamp", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  arrange(Condition, Biorep, Techrep) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(Biorep = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]","", Biorep)),
         Techrep = as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]","", Techrep))) %>%
  conditions_bp() %>%
  dplyr::select(New_condition, Levels, In, InN, Pr, PrN, Biorep, Techrep) %>%
  filter(row_number() <= n()-1)%>%
  arrange(Levels, Biorep, Techrep) %>%
  mutate(Ident = as.factor(paste0(New_condition, "_", Biorep)),
         Ident_rep = paste0(Ident, "_", Techrep))

# Specimens to exclude from the mechanical analysis. df_foul above is detected
# automatically from the tester's comment field ("tape"/"clamp"). The hardcoded
# list below adds tests that visibly failed for a reason not captured by that
# comment - the specimen slipped in the grips, showed a clamp/edge effect, or
# had a pre-existing flaw that broke it early - so their stress/strain curves do
# not reflect the material and are removed by Ident_rep.
foul_specimens <- unique(c(df_foul$Ident_rep, c("A1_2_3", "L1_3_2", "A1_3_4", "A3_1_4", "L1_2_1", "A3_2_4", "A1_1_3")))

```

Build database from files
```{r}
# 5. Build database from csv
csvs <- list.files(path.mech, pattern = "*.csv")
csv <- csvs[1]
headers <- c("Time", "Temperature", "Displacement", "Force", "Position", "Length", "Stress", "Strain", "Stiffness", "Modulus", "Compliance", "Pressure")


csv_read1 <- function(csv){
  csv
  df <- read.csv(csv, header = F, sep = "\t", skip = 53, col.names = headers, dec = ".", fileEncoding = "UTF-16LE") %>%
    dplyr::select(Time, Displacement, Force, Length, Stress, Strain, Stiffness, Modulus) %>%
    filter(!grepl('StartOfData', Time)) %>%
    mutate(origin = gsub(".csv","",csv)) %>% # Create a column named origin with the name of the file
    separate_wider_delim(origin, names = c("Experiment", "Biorep", "Techrep"), delim = "_") %>%
    separate_wider_delim(Biorep, names = c("Condition", "Biorep"), delim = "-") %>%
    as.data.frame()
  return(df)
}
```

Prepare dataframe for ss plot
```{r}
# 6. Preparation of the dataset.
# Row-level cleaning of the raw mechanical curves (purged dataset - foul specimens
# excluded - used for all the significance analyses): drop rows with missing or
# negative stress/strain, and keep the loading branch by discarding points where
# strain falls back relative to the previous row (after the first 10 rows of each
# specimen).
ss.df <- purged_df_mech %>%
  group_by(Ident_rep) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(!if_any(c(Strain, Stress), is.na),
         Strain >= 0,
         Stress >= 0,
         row_id <= 10 | is.na(lag(Strain)) | Strain <= 1.05 * lag(Strain)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-row_id) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

#str(ss.df)
```

```{r}
####
# ggpubr (for stat_pvalue_manual() below) is attached via shared/dependencies.R

# Pr letters (pairwise Wilcoxon, BH), as before
cld <- cld_wilcox_desc(ultstr.df$Stress, ultstr.df$Pr)

# One bracket per Pr, spanning its two In levels (1–4, 2–5, 3–6)
y_max   <- max(ultstr.df$Stress, na.rm = TRUE)
y_range <- diff(range(ultstr.df$Stress, na.rm = TRUE))

y_start <- 0.8      # height of the first bracket (B: conditions 1–4), in MPa
y_step  <- 0.10   # vertical gap between stacked brackets, in MPa

bracket.ultstr <- ultstr.df %>%
  distinct(Levels, Pr) %>%
  arrange(Levels) %>%
  group_by(Pr) %>%
  summarise(group1 = as.character(first(Levels)),
            group2 = as.character(last(Levels)),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label      = cld[as.character(Pr)],
         y.position = y_start + y_step * (row_number() - 1))

graph_ultstr <- ggplot(ultstr.df, aes(x = Levels, y = Stress, fill = Levels)) +
  labs(y = "Ultimate strength [MPa]", x = NULL) +
  geom_boxplot(lwd = 0.2, outlier.size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "Condition", values = my_palette, labels = conditions) +
  stat_pvalue_manual(bracket.ultstr,
                     label        = "label",
                     tip.length   = 0.01,
                     bracket.size = 0.3,
                     size         = 3.5,
                     vjust        = -0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.08))) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks  = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +  # two rows, filled left to right
  ylim(0, 1.1)
graph_ultstr
# figures already go to path.figures (results/figures), set in the setup chunk
#ggsave(paste0(path.figures, "2. Exp2_US.svg"), graph_ultstr, width=7.5, height=6.5, units="cm", scale=1.25)
```

## PCA
### Reload data without purging
```{r}
## Mechanical data
# This PCA / material-family section rebuilds the mechanical dataset from the
# UNPURGED curves (df_mech) on purpose: it keeps the foul specimens and instead
# drops only the few listed in remove_specimens below. It also rebuilds ultstr.df
# and youngs.df from this unpurged data; that does not affect the significance
# results, which are all computed earlier in the script. The row-level cleaning
# below is the same as for ss.df.
ss.df1 <- df_mech %>%
  group_by(Ident_rep) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number()) %>%
  filter(!if_any(c(Strain, Stress), is.na),
         Strain >= 0,
         Stress >= 0,
         row_id <= 10 | is.na(lag(Strain)) | Strain <= 1.05 * lag(Strain)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-row_id) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

df_thick

  group_by(Ident_rep, Ident, In, InN, Pr, PrN, New_condition, Biorep, Levels) %>%

  do(tidy(lm(Stress ~ New_strain, data = .))) %>%
  group_by(Ident_rep, Ident, In, InN, Pr, PrN, New_condition, Biorep, Levels) %>%

  left_join(area.df, by = "Ident", suffix = c("", ".dup")) %>%
```

```{r}
data_scaled <- scale(my.data2)

permanova_res <- adonis2(dist_matrix ~ group, permutations = 999)
permanova_res
```

Permanova post hoc
```{r}
pairwise_permanova <- function(data_scaled, group, p.adjust.method = "holm") {
  group_levels <- levels(group)
  combs <- combn(group_levels, 2)
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(i in 1:ncol(combs)) {
    g1 <- combs[1, i]
    g2 <- combs[2, i]
    
    idx <- group %in% c(g1, g2)
    
    sub_data <- data_scaled[idx, ]
    sub_group <- droplevels(group[idx])
    
    sub_dist <- dist(sub_data)
    
    perm <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ sub_group, permutations = 999)
    
    results <- rbind(results,
                     data.frame(
                       Comparison = paste(g1, "vs", g2),
                       p.value = perm$`Pr(>F)`[1]
                     ))
  }
  
  results$p.adj <- p.adjust(results$p.value, method = p.adjust.method)
  
  return(results)
}

pairwise_results <- pairwise_permanova(data_scaled, group)
pairwise_results

```

```{r}
# Stats
# Euclidean distance on PCA scores
scores$group <- group   # factor defining groups
dist_matrix <- dist(scores[, c("PC1", "PC2")])

adonis2(dist_matrix ~ group, data = scores, permutations = 999)


# Suppose you have PCA scores
dist_matrix <- dist(scores[, c("PC1", "PC2")])  # Euclidean distances

# Groups
groups <- scores$group

# Pairwise PERMANOVA
pairwise_permanova <- function(dist_matrix, groups, p.adjust.method = "holm") {
  group_levels <- unique(groups)
  res <- list()
  
  combs <- combn(group_levels, 2)
  
  for(i in 1:ncol(combs)) {
    g1 <- combs[1, i]
    g2 <- combs[2, i]
    sub_idx <- which(groups %in% c(g1, g2))
    sub_dist <- as.dist(as.matrix(dist_matrix)[sub_idx, sub_idx])
    sub_group <- groups[sub_idx]
    
    perm <- adonis2(sub_dist ~ sub_group, permutations = 999)
    res[[paste(g1, "vs", g2)]] <- perm$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  }
  
  # Adjust p-values
  pvals <- unlist(res)
  p.adj <- p.adjust(pvals, method = p.adjust.method)
  
  data.frame(
    Comparison = names(res),
    p.value = pvals,
    p.adj = p.adj
  )
}

pairwise_permanova(dist_matrix, groups)

```

# Material family dataframe
`fam.df` holds one row per biological replicate and is the data behind the S3
material-family figure. It is assembled from dataframes already built upstream,
so no raw input is re-read here:
```{r}
# Sources (all keyed by Ident = one biological replicate):
#   res.df               dry biomass GBM (the sample weight) + Levels
#   youngs.df            Young's modulus per specimen -> mean per replicate
#   purged_thickness_df  thickness per specimen       -> mean per replicate
#   area.df              surface area from the ImageJ CSVs (already per replicate)
fam.df <- res.df %>%
  dplyr::select(Ident, Levels, GBM) %>%
  left_join(youngs.df %>% group_by(Ident) %>% summarise(YM = mean(YM), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "Ident") %>%
  left_join(purged_thickness_df %>% group_by(Ident) %>% summarise(Thickness = mean(Thickness), .groups = "drop"),
            by = "Ident") %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(area.df, Ident, Area_m2), by = "Ident") %>%
  mutate(Volume  = Area_m2 * Thickness / 10^3,   # thickness mm -> m
         Density = GBM / 10^3 / Volume)          # kg / m^3
head(fam.df)
#write.table(fam.df, file = paste0(path.tables, "Exp2_Biorep.csv"), dec = '.', sep=",", row.names = F)
```
